strings: With all m_c's sensitive senses, it's no shock to r_c0 that sometimes the world is just too overwhelming for {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
m_c's so thankful that the Clan's set aside a quiet space just for {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to use when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/need/needs} to get away from the world.
More than a little frantic, m_c's had to find a quiet corner of the camp to try and unwind from all the excess stimulation.
